source: Schneider Electric, Series 200 and 700 Power Meter (PM200, PM700, PM750) register list, firmware 3.050

sources.title: Series 200 and 700 Power Meter (PM200, PM700, PM750) Register List with 3.050 firmware functionality

notes: Addresses are the register numbers of the register list (Modicon numbering, 1-based): the address on the wire is the register number minus 1.

The 4000 series holds integers scaled by the four scale factor registers (4105 to 4108): value = register x 10^scale factor, in the unit shown. The 1000 series holds the same values as floating-point numbers, already in engineering units.
Power factor registers 4009 and 4048: a negative signed value is reported as value + 32768 (see the register list).
The alarm configuration blocks (4140 and following, 16 registers per alarm position) are written with the command interface and are not in this map.
Registers that exist only on some of the models say so in their description.

registers.name: Usage Hours
registers.description: This combination timer counts the total time for which the absolute current on at least one phase is > 0.1Amp. Only on PM700, PM700P, PM710, PM750

registers.name: Usage Minutes
registers.description: This combination timer counts the total time for which the absolute current on at least one phase is > 0.1Amp. Only on PM700, PM700P, PM710, PM750

registers.name: Reset Counter

registers.name: Power Block Demand Number of Sub-Intervals
registers.description: 0: Sliding Block Calculation If Reg[4118 <= 15 Minutes the Sub-interval is 15 Seconds if Reg[4118 > 15 Minutes the Sub-interval is 60 Seconds 1: Fixed Block Else: Rolling Block (Must be evenly divided into 4188 to the second)

registers.name: Reset Commands
registers.description: Write a reset command code (see the notes): 666 restart demand, 1115 reset meter, 3211 default alarms, 3320 de-energize output, 3321 energize output, 3361 reset output counter, 3365 reset input counters, 6209 preset energy from 4000-4005, 10001 clear usage timers, 14255 reset min/max, 21212 reset peak demand, 30078 clear energy
